newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan groups call for international rights court.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan groups call for international rights court.

text.p: Seven Moroccan groups on Monday called on the United Nations to set up an international court to try those responsible for torture, genocide, rape and other violations of human rights.

"To put an end to the violation of human rights and all forms of torture, crimes, genocide and rape which particularly target children and women in different regions of the world...An international criminal court should be set up," the groups said in a statement faxed to Reuters.
Among those who issued the statement were the independent Moroccan association and organisation of human rights.
"We call on all members of the United Nations and the world community to support efforts aimed at setting up a permanent international court of justice," the groups said.
They asked the Moroccan government "to take all necessary political and diplomatic measures in order to put its weight during the current General Assembly meeting to materialise the court project."
